description: Inventory of all visual assets used in the Canasta web app. All card faces are generated procedurally by a single React component rather than shipped as individual image files - see 'generation' fields below.

assets.name: Standard playing card faces (52 cards: 4 suits x 13 ranks)
assets.type: svg (generated via React component, not static files)
assets.generation: src/components/Card.tsx — renders each face on demand from {rank, suit} props using inline SVG (corner rank/suit labels + pip layout table for number cards, simple ornamental glyph for J/Q/K).
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: Joker face (x2 distinct copies per deck, same visual design)
assets.generation: src/components/Card.tsx — JokerFace() renders an original geometric jester-hat glyph, no third-party clip art.
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: Card back design
assets.generation: src/components/Card.tsx — CardBackFace() renders an original diamond/cross-hatch pattern with a simple monogram, not related to any real brand.
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: App title / logo
assets.type: text + inline SVG cards (no dedicated logo file)
assets.generation: src/pages/Landing.tsx — composed from the same Card component plus styled text, no external logo asset needed.
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: Player avatars
assets.type: css/svg (colored circle + initials, no image files)
assets.generation: src/components/PlayerAvatar.tsx — solid color circle (per-player color assigned in the mock store) with computed initials text.
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: Felt table background texture
assets.generation: src/index.css — .felt-bg class using CSS radial-gradient + repeating-linear-gradient.
assets.license: original work, no third-party assets used, free to use

assets.name: Favicon
assets.generation: public/favicon.svg (Vite template default placeholder — replace with a custom mark if desired; not a third-party brand asset).

notes: No third-party card image sets, icon packs, or stock photography are used anywhere in this project.

Because card faces are generated by a component rather than pre-rendered files, there is no per-card image file to enumerate individually — the generation logic in src/components/Card.tsx is the single source of truth for all 54 unique faces (52 + 2 jokers) + the shared back design.
